visualCharacteristics.structure: intro h3 + p on the left; tall linked image cards with white h4 + text over a dark top gradient
visualCharacteristics.layout: stacked on mobile; from 1024px a 12-column grid with intro in columns 1-3 and a right-bleeding scroll-snap carousel in 5-12; round prev/next buttons and 01/09 counter below

contentPattern:
Row 1 (optional, single cell without picture): [h3 (may contain
) + p intro]. Rows 2..n: [picture] | [h4 + p description + p > a explore link]. The explore link (else a title or image link) makes the whole card a link; focal points in img data-title/title ('data-focal:x,y') become object-position.
